text:
marta: quick sync: we need a concise GA acceptance checklist for the inference product that covers SLA, docs, support, monitoring, pricing/quota, and private-deploy notes. aim to finalize Thurs.
ryan: please post the checklist bullets here.
marta: rough bullets: 1) SLOs & compensation rules, 2) public + internal docs, 3) oncall rota + runbooks, 4) monitoring & regression alerts, 5) pricing/quota mapping + migration guide, 6) private/dedicated contract addenda (kms/hsm, data retention), 7) canary & rollback plan.
camille: suggest adding: canary window duration, canary traffic % and success criteria. also include a smoke script that validates region failover and model-variant fallback.
piotr: ops ask: define exact latency targets per model tier. my proposal: p95 small < 120ms, p95 medium < 300ms, p95 large < 600ms; monthly data-plane uptime 99.9%.
ymarta: spelled marta wrong above? (typo) marta: noted. are those acceptable for GA?
ryan: Commercial note: credits for SLA breaches should be capped per invoice and have a clawback if repeated. Camille, legal needs wording.
legal-bot: reminder: include an exceptions clause for scheduled maintenance with 72h notice and emergency maintenance procedures.
camille: ok i'll draft the credit cap language, will sync with legal. also: we need token-cost regression alert (>=15% increase triggers pager).
piotr: agree. add automated alert: token-cost/unit delta, and model-quality drift (BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-similarity) if applicable.
marta: smoke test idea from infra: run 200 requests from two regions with induced region outage, expect <5% fallback rate and <2% 5xx error rate. ryan: can you own the smoke job in CI?
ryan: yes i'll add ./ci/ga_smoke_test.sh and a GH action, will post PR.
camille: private deployment note: include HSM/KMS key rotation procedure and SLA exceptions for air-gapped installs. add a one-page "customer private-install checklist".
piotr: infra flagged limited GPUs in ap-south for dual-region rehearsals. tag infra; we might use synthetic load smaller than real traffic.
ops-bot: incident note: previous dedicated rollouts had DNS propagation delays; recommend rehearsing DNS failover and recording RTO.
marta: rollout + fallback: document model-variant fallback chain (quantized -> fp16 -> small model) and automatic routing policy with cost/prio tags.
ryan: also need quota mapping doc: how committed tiers map to per-route quotas, and migration path if a customer bumps to Dedicated. Camille will own that with finance.
camille: I'll draft the migration guide + pricing appendix.
legal-bot: request: add a short data-retention + audit log clause for Private deployments and SOC-ready wording.
piotr: owners: SLO doc (piotr), monitoring + dashboards (ryan), canary + smoke tests (ryan), private install checklist (camille), legal/commercial language (camille + legal). sign-off group: PM, Eng lead, Infra lead, SRE, Legal.
marta: timeline: drafts by Wed COB, legal review Thu AM, final sign-off Thu 3pm. anyone blocked?
ryan: blocked on exact runtime p95 numbers for some large models pinging runtime team.
piotr: blocked on infra capacity for dual-region rehearsal; will raise with infra leads.
ops-bot: reminder: previous GA required 2 runbooks linked: deploy rollback and urgent latency mitigation.
marta: thanks everyone. i'll collate into one-pager and drop into #shiproom after sign-offs. please add short commits or PR links when you post drafts. :thumbsup:
